name: Simple Sound Room
author: FrancescoA
description:
Press right button while moving the mouse to orient the view and use WASD and/or arrow keys to move the camera.
Sounds / Effects are:
   - Jukebox starts a loop when you reach it (thx Lord Feder!)
   - A piano start playing behind a door when you go near it
   - The fire crackles
   - The canvas lights are buzzing
   - Reverb
